environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via public Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy, no load balancer, no WAF. Application runs as systemd service under 'appuser' account. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions.
